convention: Labels are the design intent set when each element was created, from the schema descriptions; no classifier output was used. Piping: process services and the flare line are PIP/PRC, cooling water, steam and condensate are PIP/UTL (flare alt UTL), all with division 40; fittings, spool joints, nozzle flanges, tees and spectacle blinds follow their line (a nozzle flange alt: the equipment's sub-discipline). Valves are PIP/VLV; a regulating valve with an F-tag is a control valve, INS/CTL; transmitters and gauges are INS/SNS. Pumps, their motors and baseplates are PIP/PMP division 43 (motor alt division 26, baseplate alt EQP, SUP); exchangers with channel and saddles are PIP/HTX division 42; drums and skirts are PIP/VES division 43. Pipe sleepers, T-supports and riser guides are PIP/SUP division 40 (alt 05 steel or 03 concrete); cable tray supports and the tray riser stanchion follow the tray, ELE/CND (alt division 05). Foundations under equipment are CIV/FND, under rack and platform steel STR/FND, both division 03. Rack steel is STR (COL, BEM, BRC; base plates BRC), platform grating STR/SLB, stair and railings ARC/STA division 05. Masonry exterior walls are load bearing, STR/WLS 04; the block partition is ARC/WAL 04; floor and roof slabs are STR/SLB 03 (roof alt division 07). Doors ARC/DOR and windows ARC/WIN, division 08. Paving, roads and kerbs CIV/PAV 32, fence posts CIV/LND 32, drain trench CIV/DRN 33. Switchboards ELE/PWR, cable tray ELE/CND, luminaires ELE/LTG, division 26. The battery-limit marker board is a sign that fits no discipline: GEN/UNC with division 10. IfcSpace and IfcOpeningElement are not kept by the converter and have no entry.
